theorems.name: Submission.codim1_ac_pp_setIntegral_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) (Φ : α → β) (A : Set α) (B : Set β) (J : α → ℝ) (f : β → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ J x) → (∀ g : β → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in B, g y ∂ν = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (Φ x) ∂μ) → Integrable f (ν.restrict B) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => J x * f (Φ x)) (μ.restrict A) → Integrable (fun x => J x * f (Φ x)) (μ.restrict A) ∧ ∫ y in B, f y ∂ν = ∫ x in A, J x * f (Φ x) ∂μ
